# Cost view of the trade-off curves (generated by code/cost_view.py)

Cost per unit of demand in weeks of holding: C(r) = inventory_weeks + r · (1 − fill rate), r = lost-sales penalty / weekly holding rate. Each method uses its cheapest τ. Regret = cost / cheapest single method − 1.
Reference points: r ≈ 78 for a 20% annual holding rate and a 30% lost margin; r ≈ 650 for the cost parameters of Theodorou et al. (2025).
